maintainability_candidates.summary: Five export adapters repeat authorization/session/error/audit/commit/observation metadata and inspect/prepare/resume orchestration. A small typed shared invocation adapter could reduce drift; per-family source support, lock-busy exception policies and immutable receipt/recovery semantics must remain explicit. No refactor during global source freeze.

source_observations: Read-only registry gates are distinct from current per-invocation authorization; dynamic read views independently recheck their complete section union and use a static handler catalog.

Generic dashboard readers are superadmin-scoped through MCPReadContext._actor and scrub protected URLs/keys through shared ReadProjection, so presentation adapter SQL without an independent current-user predicate does not by itself demonstrate tenant leakage.

Owned WhatsApp/GC intent inspection can refresh durable progress metadata; it does not redispatch provider sends. This is intentional documented catch-up, not proof of business-read purity for every service.
limits: No new tests/services/real credentials/provider calls executed in this read-only lane.
MCP matrix classification is owned by ai_extraction and was not used as physical-read evidence.
Downstream application/resource/file streaming implementations are not all independently fully reviewed by this ledger.
